text: Design and evaluation of a decentralized urban governance system with embedded AI and blockchain-enabled IoT supplies a concrete architecture in which embedded AI proposes governance actions and blockchain smart contracts validate execution. This is consistent with Kaal's prediction that AI and blockchain will supply governance solutions. The validation is technical and controlled, expressly excludes real-world policy implementation, and does not establish feasibility for corporate boards, so the relationship is a narrow qualification.
